name: AryaXR Switchboard Electrical Wiring
summary:
Step into a hazard-free virtual workshop to learn the fundamentals of electrical wiring! The AryaXR Switchboard Electrical Wiring Simulator provides students with a fully immersive, hands-on educational experience covering the wiring procedures for fan regulators, two-way switches, and standard switches.

Understand not just how to connect the wires, but why proper procedures are vital, and experience the consequences of skipped safety steps in a completely safe environment.
